title: Scalar composition gauge no-go
theorem: For a C1 associative scalar law F with two-sided identity 1 and phi(x)=partial_2 F(x,1)>0, L(x)=integral_1^x du/phi(u) satisfies L(F(a,b))=L(a)+L(b).
pdt_consequence: An uncalibrated smooth scalar composition law is not invariant physical novelty; it is additive after a monotone calibration coordinate. PDT composition novelty must fix the operational calibration independently or reside in non-scalar global distinction structure.
limitations: Requires C1 regularity and positive marginal speed.
Does not determine the full composite state/effect space.
Does not imply a same-input PDT-vs-QM deviation.
Underlying associativity representation is classical prior art.
next_target: Derive an operationally fixed calibration and admissible global distinction structure from PDT primitives, or prove that candidate derivations are insufficient.
